whenToUse: Using the xurl skill's upstream workflow, guardrails, and local-tool assumptions.

keyConcepts.explanation: Never read, print, summarize, upload, or paste ~/.xurl into LLM context. Never ask the user to paste client secrets, bearer tokens, or OAuth tokens into chat. Never use --verbose in agent runs; it can expose auth headers. Do not run auth commands with inline secret flags in an agent session. The user must register app credentials manually on their machine outside the agent session.
